meta.title: Quantity Surveyor
meta.tagline: Manage construction costs from estimation to final account.
meta.description: Quantity surveyors estimate costs, prepare bills of quantities, manage contracts and control project finances to ensure construction projects are delivered within budget.

details.description: Quantity surveyors estimate costs, prepare bills of quantities, manage contracts and control project finances to ensure construction projects are delivered within budget.
details.whyLearn: Manage construction costs from estimation to final account. Quantity surveyors estimate costs, prepare bills of quantities, manage contracts and control project finances to ensure construction projects are delivered within budget.
